title: AeroDynamic Aviation
specs: Established in 1960, widely respected in the Bay Area.
Only flight school in greater Northern California offering diverse aircraft fleet including tailwheel and aerobatic planes.
Locations primarily experience beautiful sunny skies making weather cancellations rare.
Specialized instructors for mountain pass and coastal IFR training.

services.name: Flight Training
services.desc: We understand that learning to fly is expensive. If you wish to train faster than your regular cash flow allows, financing may be an option for you. While you will be paying finance charges, you may take fewer flights if you can fly more often without large gaps between lessons. We have been providing the finest in flight training since 1960. We pride ourselves in teaching students the art of flying safely and proficiently. We offer flight training for Sport Pilot, Private Pilot, Tailwheel, Aerobatics, Instrument, Commercial, CFI, ATP, Multi, and provide ground training for all. blurb: Aerodynamic Aviation offers flight training from beginner to advanced levels including private pilot, commercial pilot, and ATP certifications. They provide aircraft rental and specialized training such as aerobatics and flight instructor courses. Their fleet includes a variety of aircraft types including tailwheel, tricycle gear, and multi-engine trainers.
